_prompt:
You are generating monthly game titles for Geodashing, a GPS-based outdoor game where players travel to randomly generated global coordinates (dashpoints) each month regardless of whether the point lands in a swamp, thicket, mountainside, or middle of nowhere.

Tone & Style Guidelines:
- Tone: Dry, deadpan, witty British understatement (in the spirit of Douglas Adams or P.G. Wodehouse meets cartography).
- Core Themes:
  * Cartography & GPS: Satellites, coordinates, contour lines, triangulation, map errors, bearing, precision vs. accuracy.
  * Physical Reality: Bushwhacking, mud, briars, barbed wire, elevation, steep terrain, swamps, dubious footwear.
  * Human Delusion: Stubbornness, misplaced confidence, recalculations, wishful thinking, mild regret.
- Length: 4 to 8 words per title. Title Case.
- Avoid: Generic hype, exclamation marks, or overt gamer tropes. Titles should feel like dry literary chapter titles or wry navigational observations.

Task: Generate [N] new game titles starting from [YYYY-MM]. Output the result as a valid JSON object mapping 'YYYY-MM' to 'Title'.
